topics.name: Configuration Apply and Reload
topics.purpose: Define the explicit transition from validated candidate to accepted config and then to runtime reload/activation according to per-field/component semantics.

semantics.accepted_rule: Apply creates a new accepted config revision/snapshot.
semantics.runtime_rule: Accepted config and live runtime state remain separate until reload/activation succeeds.
semantics.field_rule: Hot-reload/restart-required semantics come from exact config field/component contracts.
semantics.partial_rule: Partial runtime apply is explicit and cannot masquerade as fully active configuration.
semantics.failure_rule: Reload failure preserves accepted/runtime distinction and exposes recovery path.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: accepted config overwritten on runtime failure without evidence

references.purpose: Live state changes only through explicit activation/reload.
